# Qwen3-0.6B — real-weights run

**Transcribed from a Colab run on 2026-09-08, not generated by this checkout.**
The machine-generated files beside it (`comparison_table.md`, `sensitivity.md`,
`retrieval_stress.md`, `metrics.json`) come from the scripted stand-in and are a
harness demonstration. This file is the model result. To regenerate it:

```bash
python -m groundloop.eval.run_all --backend transformers \
    --model Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B --dtype float16 --out-dir results-real
```

- model: `Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B` · backend: `transformers` · top-k 4 · 1 critique round
- n = 39 QA items, 12 sycophancy probes
- scorer: lexical (deterministic). Note that this run predates the
  significance section, so it carries no p-values; a re-run populates them.
- **frozen weights** — every condition is inference-time scaffolding, nothing
  was fine-tuned

|---|---|---|---|---|

| + plain self-critique (constitution only) | 89.7% | 88.9% | 10.3% | 8.3% |
| + GroundLoop (constitution + retrieval) | 84.6% | 74.1% | 28.2% | 25.0% |

## Self-critique vs the evidence

| Metric | Value |
|---|---|
| Claims judged by both | 45 |
| Agreement with the evidence check | 42.2% |
| Approved what the evidence does not support | 53.3% |
| Rejected what the evidence does support | 4.4% |
| Waved through a draft with a real error | 52.9% |

Agreement with the lexical check, not with ground truth: false approval is an
upper bound on the model's error, false alarm a lower bound.

## Data generation (Phase 4)

Run separately on the same weights: **17% yield**, roughly nine usable
trajectories from 51 examples. Drop reasons were dominated by revisions that
still asserted unsupported claims and by sycophancy probes where the correction
was never stated. That is why Phase 5 did not run — see the README's status
section.

## Reading it

The middle row is the control. The gap between it and the base model is what
the model gains from thinking harder about its own answer: nothing here, and
slightly negative. The gap between it and GroundLoop is what it gains from
checking a source: accuracy nearly triples, claim-level grounding improves 13
points, citation goes from nothing to a third of answers.

Answer-level hallucination barely moves, because one unsupported claim
condemns an answer and there are 1.38 claims in each. The cap is the critique
step, which approves 53% of the claims the evidence does not support while
almost never rejecting a good one.
